profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Microsoft
profile.summary: Software engineer with experience in a variety of areas including: software development, software testing, and IT support. Possesses a comprehensive understanding of various programming languages and techniques. Has experience working in the manufacturing industry and is a self motivated individual who works well in team based and individual settings

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.insights: Rust (Programming Language), Kusto Query Language (KQL) and +1 skill

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Backend development for device features using C# and Kotlin for Rockwell’s FactoryTalk Design Studio software

positions.title: Leadership Development Program, Product Engineering & Development
positions.description:
Rotation 4: Software Engineer/Product Owner (January 2021 - June 2021)
·	Developed features for an IT/OT data convergence product that helps customers improve manufacturing productivity and accelerate digital transformation 
·	Responsible for working with key stakeholders to prioritize the backlog for implementation of features based on customer value for FactoryTalk Edge Gateway 

Rotation 3: Project Manager (June 2020 - December 2020)
·	Created commercial and technical collateral to support Rockwell’s ongoing Annual Recurring Revenue transformation to subscriptions

Rotation 2: Software Engineer (January 2020 - June 2020)
·	Developed an Administrator service for a FactoryTalk Analytics LogixAI user to manage and configure their embedded appliance 
·	Developed a scalable help feature for LogixAI users to use as a reference as new features are released

Rotation 1: EIT Training & Remote Technical Support (June 2019 - December 2019)
·	Provided remote technical support for Rockwell customers and engineers with ControlLogix, Flex I/O, and PLC-5 product families 
·	Completed Engineer in Training (EIT) program focused on core Rockwell product technologies

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Developed chatbot capability for FactoryTalk Analytics for Devices to lookup fault code information for twenty plus Rockwell devices
- Developed automated test ware for regression testing on current and prototype Rockwell Programmable Logic Controllers
- Performed weekly quality assurance testing for firmware builds of Studio 5000 Logix Designer
- Implemented automated process to incorporate manufacturer risk index data into PCB design software to streamline productivity in the engineering design process of new and existing PCB designs
-Developed an internal tool to manage hardware and scheduling of Programmable Logix Controller regression testing at various Rockwell corporate offices

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description: Managed integrated workplace management system to maintain documents and work order requests

honors.title: Dean's List
honors.description: Completed semester with a grade point average greater than 3.5 for Spring of 2017.
honors.issuer: Issued by The Ohio State University · May 2017

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Ohio State Diversity, Outreach and Inclusion Office -  PREFACE Program
volunteerExperiences.description:
Taught incoming first-year engineering students (majoring in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science & Engineering) the basics of computer science and potential career paths:
- Variables, conditionals, loops
- Arrays
- Object-Oriented Programming (Classes, Objects, and Interfaces)
- GitHub

company.name: Ohio State Diversity, Outreach and Inclusion Office -  PREFACE Program

organizations.name: Cleveland Water Department - Student Technical Enrichment Program
organizations.description: Participated in STEP program where Cleveland Water Department introduced middle school students to different fields of engineering. The program consisted of meeting once a month to go on field trips at different colleges and companies located throughout Northeast Ohio.
